schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Laurel Lake #2 (Region 6, Mono Co.) for fingerling-size Golden Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of August-September. Laurel Lake #2 is one of the two Laurel Lakes basins at the head of Laurel Canyon southeast of Mammoth Lakes; CDFW's numeric #1/#2 designations are not publicly mapped to a specific basin, so this record is placed in the upper (northeast) basin by convention. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
